business_problem: Tipalti wanted internal teams to explore business data with AI without needing specialist prompt or data skills, but it also needed to avoid the privacy, security, orchestration, and operational overhead that would come from moving sensitive finance data into separate inference infrastructure.
solution_summary: Tipalti built an “AI prompt store” inside Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud on AWS using Cortex AI, Snowpark, and native SQL functions. Predefined LLM prompts are exposed to sales and marketing users so they can analyze opportunities and account groups directly in tools such as Salesforce without learning prompt engineering or moving data outside the warehouse. AI_COMPLETE brings model calls into SQL workflows, TRY_COMPLETE makes large batch executions more resilient, and a custom Snowpark function runs multiple prompt queries in parallel so the system can scale throughput up to fivefold. Because the prompts, governance, and source data all stay inside Snowflake, Tipalti eliminated the need for external inference services and complex orchestration layers while still delivering fast, consistent AI-assisted analysis. The design gives internal teams always-on access to trusted insights and a path toward richer RAG and semantic models entirely inside the Snowflake stack.

solution_components.name: Snowflake AI Data Cloud
solution_components.role: Holds Tipalti's governed data and serves as the platform for AI-assisted exploration.

solution_components.name: Cortex AI
solution_components.role: Provides the LLM capabilities used by Tipalti's AI prompt store and SQL-based analysis flows.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs the custom parallel-query function that increases throughput and responsiveness for prompt execution.

solution_components.name: Salesforce
solution_components.role: Receives embedded AI insights where sales teams already work.

data_flow: Business data remains in Snowflake, predefined prompts call Cortex AI through SQL and Snowpark, results are generated in parallel, and the resulting insights are surfaced to internal teams directly in Snowflake-connected business tools such as Salesforce.
business_outcome: Tipalti can run five times more queries simultaneously, has deployed more than 10 features to over 50 users, completed more than 600 ad-hoc analyses, and gives internal teams fast, low-overhead AI insights without introducing external infrastructure or privacy tradeoffs.
